description: List the US states (and DC) that match one rule in BackPR's state rules data: every person must report suspected child abuse; camps need a state license (all camp types, only some or none statewide); or the staff-to-child ratio for school-age children, 3-year-olds or 4-year-olds in licensed childcare centers. Use it for questions like "Which states require everyone to report abuse?" or "Which state has the strictest school-age ratio?". Returns each matching state with its value and backpr.com links. Ratio rules list every state with a confirmed ratio, strictest first; the others list matching states by name.

rule.description: "everyone_must_report": states where every person must report suspected child abuse. "camp_license_required": day and overnight camps need a state license. "camp_license_partial": only some camp types need one. "no_statewide_camp_license": no statewide camp license. "school_age_ratio", "ratio_3_year_olds", "ratio_4_year_olds": staff-to-child ratios in licensed centers.

name: list_states_by_rule

not_confirmed.description: Ratio rules only: states without a confirmed ratio

source_url.description: The backpr.com national page for this rule

max_group.description: Ratio rules only: maximum group size, when the state sets one

state_page_url.description: The section on the state's backpr.com rules page

url.description: This state's row on the backpr.com national page

value.description: The rule value, e.g. "1:15", "Yes" or "Some camp types need a state license"

title: Compare states by rule
